parameters.jsonBody:
={{ {
  statement: `
    MERGE (m:Movie {imdbId: $movie.imdbId})
    SET m.title = $movie.title,
        m.year = $movie.year,
        m.runtimeMinutes = $movie.runtimeMinutes,
        m.imdbRating = $movie.imdbRating,
        m.plot = $movie.plot,
        m.source = $movie.source,
        m.dataSource = $movie.dataSource,
        m.embeddingText = $movie.embeddingText

    FOREACH (name IN $movie.directors |
      MERGE (p:Person {name: name})
      MERGE (m)-[:DIRECTED_BY]->(p)
    )

    FOREACH (name IN $movie.actors |
      MERGE (p:Person {name: name})
      MERGE (p)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m)
    )

    FOREACH (name IN $movie.genres |
      MERGE (g:Genre {name: name})
      MERGE (m)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g)
    )

    RETURN m.imdbId AS imdbId, m.title AS title
  `,
  parameters: {
    movie: $json
  }
} }}
